summary: Azul S.A. (issuer) filed a Form 6-K reporting the delivery of subscription warrants under its restructuring plan approved in Chapter 11 bankruptcy. The registrant issued three series: American Subscription Warrants (4.81T total, ~82.2% to American Airlines), GUC Subscription Warrants (886.29B, ~99.8% to the GUC Trust for creditors), and Additional Investment Subscription Warrants (1.20T, ~82.2% to United/other investors). Preemptive rights were inadvertently oversold; the issuer will issue additional warrants to fulfill Chapter 11 obligations. Trading begins May 27, 2026. This reflects post-restructuring warrant issuance and share dilution management. Monitor trading liquidity and potential dilution impacts on common equity.
